description: Source code for the ContactOperations helper class, which manages batch operations for storing and updating contact data in Android's contacts content provider.

classes.name: ContactOperations
classes.description: Helper class for constructing batch operations to add or update contact data in Android's contacts provider.

methods.name: createNewContact
methods.description: Creates a new contact in the contacts provider with specified user ID and account info.

methods.name: updateExistingContact
methods.description: Prepares operations to update an existing contact identified by rawContactId.

methods.name: addName
methods.description: Adds a contact name, either full or separated first and last names.

methods.name: addEmail
methods.description: Adds an email address to the contact.

methods.name: addPhone
methods.description: Adds a phone number with specified type.

methods.name: addGroupMembership
methods.description: Assigns the contact to a group by group ID.

methods.name: addAvatar
methods.description: Downloads and adds an avatar image from a URL.

methods.name: addProfileAction
methods.description: Adds a profile action with user ID.

methods.name: updateServerId
methods.description: Updates the contact's server ID.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the contact's email if it has changed.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the contact's name, either full or separated first and last names.

methods.name: updateDirtyFlag
methods.description: Sets the dirty flag for the contact.

methods.name: updatePhone
methods.description: Updates the contact's phone number.

methods.name: updateAvatar
methods.description: Updates the contact's avatar image from a URL.

methods.name: updateProfileAction
methods.description: Updates the profile action with user ID.

methods.name: addInsertOp
methods.description: Adds an insert operation to the batch.

methods.name: addUpdateOp
methods.description: Adds an update operation to the batch.

methods.name: newInsertCpo
methods.description: Creates a new insert ContentProviderOperation builder with sync adapter parameter.

methods.name: newUpdateCpo
methods.description: Creates a new update ContentProviderOperation builder with sync adapter parameter.

methods.name: newDeleteCpo
methods.description: Creates a new delete ContentProviderOperation builder with sync adapter parameter.

methods.name: addCallerIsSyncAdapterParameter
methods.description: Adds sync adapter query parameter to URI if operation is a sync.
